method: Full pinned source read with blob verification. Original AST finish/chart callbacks executed using fake model and scheduled timers. Initial harness invocation omitted signal argument and failed; corrected invocation supplied it and completed.
findings: Finish callback sets Finished scanning and progress100 even with non-null error; warning is shown but delayed render enables script controls whenever model has leaves. Original control with partial-result model confirms that path. No actual script generation or GTK subprocess was executed.
is_running is set true at trigger and not cleared by finish; original finish control retains true. Reset is the only explicit false assignment in this view.

Delayed render callbacks capture no run identifier and are not cancelled at reset; an old scheduled callback can observe the current model after rerun. Cross-run effects require actual event-loop qualification.
trigger_run starts runner before replacing model; correctness depends on asynchronous callback ordering. No synchronous-signal failure claimed.
Script generation marks _script_generated and switches to editor immediately after requesting replay, without waiting here for completion. Lower-level runner failure handling was audited separately.
Default action passes trie.root directly as nodes, while explicit all-script action passes a one-element list; consequences depend on root iteration semantics. No failure claimed without that check.
Filtered and selected actions use current tree model, whereas all uses original model; earlier filter-cache omissions therefore matter to exposed selection scope.

executed_control.subtitle: Finished scanning.
executed_control.scope: Original callbacks; fake model with two partial-result rows; no GTK or real subprocess.

limits: Source callback control only; no visual or installed GUI proof.
